title: Transitivity of separable algebraic extensions
statement: Let $k\subseteq E\subseteq F$ be a tower of field extensions [def-pc-field-extension]. If $E/k$ and $F/E$ are separable algebraic extensions [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], then $F/k$ is a separable algebraic extension.
